description: Register every currently-live provider leaf so the hub federates what exists today: cli-health.commands, ui-health.surfaces, ui-health.widgets, swarm-manager.records, swarm-manager.backlog, swarm-manager.initiative, prompt-manager.skill, prompt-manager.action, and knowledge-observatory.docs (when its semantic-search cutover lands). Each is a declarative descriptor + ResultMapping, non-destructive to the owning scenario.

requirements.title: All live leaves registered
requirements.description: The eight live leaves (plus KO docs when ready) are registered with valid descriptors and ResultMappings per Appendix A.5 of the plan; each registers without modifying its owning scenario's existing search.

validation.notes: ListProviders returns all live leaves with ACTIVE state and valid mappings.
A federated query reaches multiple groups (cli-health, ui-health, swarm-manager, prompt-manager) and returns mapped hits.
